about: The polish cases of three changes of 2026-11-17 (GAPS S190, S191, S192), in the shape of polish.json: the record card as an outline, a Wwise event's name and path beside its GUID, and a tagged text in another language from the plugin's own strings tables. In a file of their own so that other fixes' cases don't collide with them.

cases.title: sfs_record: the card is an outline; the fields view opens a closed part and the full view opens them all (GAPS S192)
cases.before: The Beowulf's card was 618 lines: its 21 object template combinations took 442 of them, and 66 of its 93 fields came only with a second call. The card now closes a list or object of more than 12 lines to one line.

pass_if.name: the outline has the record's own fields to the last one in one answer, closes the long parts with their line counts and says how to open them; the fields view opens one; the full view closes nothing

all.matches: (?m)^  Combination \(ObjectTemplates\): 21 items   \[closed: \d+ lines\. The fields view of ObjectTemplates opens it; the full view opens every one\]$
The card is an outline: 4 long lists or objects are closed

cases.title: A sound's event by its Wwise name and path: on the card and by wwise_name() and wwise_path() in query2 (GAPS S191)
cases.before: The Eon's equip sound was shown as {59A5EC16-836F-4D41-A2D7-FC1B91F934D7} alone; xEdit shows Play_WPN_Pistol_Eon_Equip_Up and the event's path in the Wwise project beside it. The names are in the sound banks' descriptions the game and mods ship (sound\soundbanks\*.json).

params.sql: SELECT EditorID, wwise_name(Equip_StartEvent) AS Name, wwise_path(Equip_StartEvent) AS Path, wwise_name(NULL) AS None FROM Weapon WHERE EditorID = 'Eon';

pass_if.name: the event's name before the GUID and its path after it, as xEdit shows them; the same name and path in a query; no name for no GUID

cases.title: A text behind the Creation Kit's tag, asked in another language, is the plugin's own strings table's text; in English the plugin's own (GAPS S190)
cases.before: darkstar.esm isn't localized: each text is in the plugin behind a tag (<ID=00008A14>Vile Weapon Crafting), and its archive ships strings tables in nine languages under those IDs. text(Name, 'de') gave the plugin's English text.

params.sql: SELECT Name, text(Name, 'de') AS German, text(Name, 'ja') AS Japanese, json(Json -> '$.Name') AS J FROM Keyword WHERE FormKey = '000066:darkstar.esm';

pass_if.name: the German table's text for German, the plugin's own for English and for a language whose table says the same; Json has Value and Tables; the card says which text it gives; a text changed since the tables were made keeps the plugin's wording in English and says what the table holds

all.matches: (?m)^\| Vile Weapon Crafting \| Böswillige Waffenherstellung \| Vile Weapon Crafting \| \{"TargetLanguage":"English","Value":"<ID=00008A14>Vile Weapon Crafting","Tables":\{[^}]*"German":"Böswillige Waffenherstellung"
given in German from their plugin's own strings tables
(?m)^  Name \(FULL\): Böswillige Waffenherstellung   \[4 languages\]   \[from the plugin's own German strings table; the plugin itself stores: Vile Weapon Crafting\]$
darkstar\.esm isn't localized, but ships strings tables of its own
the plugin's own English strings table says: Ship Part Disabler
